changelog:
### New Features
- Upgrade box now shows a 'View Pricing' ghost button linking to the configured pricing page
- Admin can customize: Upgrade CTA text, 'View Pricing' label, and the feature bullet list
- Feature list builder (add/remove rows) in Settings ? General ? Upgrade Box Customization
- Dropdown gap bug fixed (padding-top bridge)
- Pricing link hover redesigned (solid gradient on hover)
